description: In-game reference for SharpMUSH: every command and function, the configuration options, and worked softcode examples. SharpMUSH is a PennMUSH-compatible MUSH server whose in-game programming language is called softcode.
rules: SharpMUSH uses a DSL also referred to as 'softcode' for in-game programming
Avoid functions with side-effects, favor commands and commandlists instead when manipulating data where possible
Attribute trees are separated by backticks, never dots: CMD`SETRANK, DATA`GUILD. A tree path is just an attribute name, so anywhere a name is accepted a path is accepted
A function that follows literal text needs [brackets] to evaluate; a bare %-substitution like %0 or %q<name> must never be bracketed
Validate with @assert or @break guards, one specific error per check, rather than nested @switch ladders
if(), @assert, @break and filterbool() already test truthiness, so t() inside them is redundant; filter() and filterq() are the exception and keep only exactly 1
Use %i0 or itext(0) for the current element of @dolist and iter(). ## is substituted textually before evaluation, so elements run as code and nesting resolves to the outermost loop
Never re-evaluate stored player text with u(); read it with get() or v(). s() re-evaluates and secure() corrupts input
The event handler #9 and HTTP handler #8 are pre-created and already configured; add an attribute to them rather than creating or configuring a handler
